_readme: Overreach champion CONCEPT art — Stage 0 of the animated-boss overhaul.
V2: MONSTROUS HUMANOIDS. V1 rendered all three as tragic elderly humans and was
rejected by Raheem — they read as characters, not bosses, and several had no

V3: the Seraph champion is REPLACED by a NECROMANCER champion, 'The Unclosed Rite'. Raheem: the split-down-the-midline design is great but is not a Seraph. Renamed off 'Summons' because Necromancer Bible avoid explicitly lists 'Necromancer reduced to summoner'. Its avoid list also bans green smoke shorthand, skull overload and corpse decoration, so the split is SUBSTANCE VS ABSENCE — one half present, one half already gone — never half-rotted. Palette is bone/umber/iron/indigo with cold blue-white light. No green. seedBosses still needs mirrorArchetype Seraph->Necromancer and a matching resistance profile.
menace at all. The first batch is kept at out/bosses-v1-human/ for reference.
Monstrous changes the BODY, not the moral read. The Overreach premise is that
each champion walked their archetype's path past its end and it consumed them,
so the transformation IS the tragedy. Bible §14 bans automatic villainy, not
inhuman anatomy — these are tragic monsters, never cackling villains. No
snarling, no evil grins, no trophies.
Constraints that did NOT change: portrait modesty (M5.7) applies to monsters
too — armour, hide, robes, carapace, never sexualised anatomy. The Seraph
champion is Balanced-paralysis and must never read Fallen: no molten obsidian,
no black light, no horns, no hellfire. Infernal is player-exclusive.
These are NOT final assets. Each approved concept is cropped to <=168x168 and
handed to PixelLab create-character-pro as `reference_image`, which does the
pixelisation — hence painterly, not pixel art. Big bold silhouettes matter far
more than fine detail: at ~180px sprite height, fine detail is sub-pixel.
STYLE-REF IS OFF for exploration. At Mid strength the controlnet homogenised
the IDEAS as well as the register — every champion inherited the anchor's
cowl, skirt and neutral A-pose and the distinctive concepts were flattened.
Consistency belongs on the three CHOSEN designs, not on the exploration.

cast.line: A towering monstrous hag, gaunt and hunched with unnaturally long sinewy limbs, ashen grey-green leathery skin drawn tight over a heavy misshapen frame, a long jaw, sunken luminous eyes and thin white hair hanging in ropes. She is buried under an enormous load of iron: dozens of heavy iron counting-weights and thick chains heaped across her hunched back and shoulders, coiling down her overlong arms and pooling in a great pile around her clawed feet, so much that the iron is the largest shape in the picture and she is bowed forward beneath it, still standing, enduring rather than straining. Her chest and torso are a flat blocky slab of muscle and bone with no feminine contour at all, bulk and mass only, wrapped completely in ragged heavy sackcloth and boiled leather. Sorrowful exhausted expression, not angry. Muted cold grey iron, ashen grey-green hide, oxblood leather, old bronze.

states.label: Debt-Bearer B — Iron grown into her
states.line: A towering monstrous hag into whose body the iron has GROWN: heavy black iron counting-weights and chain links erupt directly out of her hunched spine, shoulders and forearms, fused into the flesh where metal and ashen grey-green hide have knitted together, a ridge of hanging iron stones running down her back like a second spine. Gaunt and enormous, long sinewy limbs, a long jaw, sunken luminous eyes, thin white rope-like hair. Her chest and torso are a flat blocky slab of muscle and bone with no feminine contour at all, bulk and mass only, wrapped completely in ragged heavy sackcloth and boiled leather. She stands hunched and patient, head low. Sorrowful and tired, not angry. Muted cold grey iron, ashen grey-green hide, oxblood leather, old bronze.

states.label: Debt-Bearer C — Dragging the chain
states.line: An enormous hunched monstrous hag whose impossibly long arms reach the ground, dragging behind her a vast tangle of heavy iron chain and counting-weights that trails across the floor and heaps in the distance, the chain fastened to thick iron cuffs bolted through her wrists. Gaunt heavy frame, ashen grey-green leathery hide, long jaw, sunken luminous eyes, thin white hair in ropes. Her chest and torso are a flat blocky slab of muscle and bone with no feminine contour at all, bulk and mass only, wrapped completely in ragged heavy sackcloth and boiled leather. Head bowed, still walking forward. Sorrowful and exhausted, not angry. Muted cold grey iron, ashen grey-green hide, oxblood leather, old bronze.

states.label: Still Season A — Root colossus
states.line: A towering monstrous humanoid grown entirely out of living wood and moss, three times the height of a man: a massive barrel torso of knotted grey bark and thick packed green moss completely sheathing the chest, waist and hips with no bare skin anywhere, vast heavy arms of braided root reaching to the ground, thick root-legs splayed and gripping the earth. Where its head should be there is only a small withered ancient face set deep in the bark, its eyes pale and calm and unfocused, not glowing. Dozens of small green leaves hang suspended and completely motionless in the air all around it, none of them falling. Sorrowful and still, never angry. Muted olive, umber, grey bark and deep moss green, with a soft warm gold-green glow deep inside the chest cavity.

states.label: Still Season B — Bloated overgrowth
states.line: A colossal bloated humanoid mass of unstoppable growth, a swollen mound in the rough shape of a hunched giant: dense layered moss, thick knotted roots, ferns, creepers and pale fungal shelves piled over and through it until almost nothing structural is visible, two heavy root-arms hanging at its sides and a single gaunt bark-covered face pressed into the front of the mass near the top, eyes open and sorrowful. Everything is green and thriving and far too much of it. Muted olive, umber, deep moss green and grey bark, with a soft warm gold-green glow buried deep inside.

states.label: Still Season C — Deadwood cage + blossom
states.line: A tall gaunt monstrous humanoid of grey deadwood and pale blossom: a lean elongated figure whose body is a cage of bare woven branches with a hollow chest, long thin branch-limbs ending in splayed twig fingers, and a smooth featureless bark head with no eyes and no mouth. Perfect unwithered white and pink blossoms grow thickly along its shoulders, arms and ribs, and more hang suspended completely motionless in the air around it. Still and mournful. Muted grey bark, olive and umber against soft pale blossom pink and white, with a faint warm gold-green glow inside the hollow chest.

states.label: Unclosed Rite A — Substance and absence
states.line: A colossal monstrous armoured figure, far taller and broader than a person, divided perfectly in half down the exact vertical centre line of its body. It stands rigidly straight and symmetrical, arms held at its sides, wearing heavy plain unornamented plate over full-length dark grave-cloth, completely covered. Its helm is smooth and featureless with no face. Imposing, solemn and sorrowful, never cruel and never gleeful. Palette strictly bone-white, grave-earth umber, cold iron grey and deep muted indigo, lit by a cold pale blue-white light. No green anywhere. Its LEFT half is solid and materially present: real weight, real armour, real shadow. Its RIGHT half is an empty shell — the same plate armour is there in outline but there is nothing inside it, only a deep cold hollow darkness visible through the joints and the gap at the neck, as though that half of the body simply is not there any more. Cold pale blue-white light leaks from the hollow.

states.label: Unclosed Rite B — Solid and unravelling
states.line: A colossal monstrous armoured figure, far taller and broader than a person, divided perfectly in half down the exact vertical centre line of its body. It stands rigidly straight and symmetrical, arms held at its sides, wearing heavy plain unornamented plate over full-length dark grave-cloth, completely covered. Its helm is smooth and featureless with no face. Imposing, solemn and sorrowful, never cruel and never gleeful. Palette strictly bone-white, grave-earth umber, cold iron grey and deep muted indigo, lit by a cold pale blue-white light. No green anywhere. Its LEFT half is solid, whole and heavy. Its RIGHT half is coming apart into fine drifting grey ash and dust, the armour and the body beneath it breaking into thousands of small particles that stream slowly upward and away into the dark, thinning until the outer edge of that half has almost nothing left. The dividing line down its centre is perfectly clean.

states.label: Unclosed Rite C — The figure and its afterimage
states.line: A colossal monstrous armoured figure, far taller and broader than a person, divided perfectly in half down the exact vertical centre line of its body. It stands rigidly straight and symmetrical, arms held at its sides, wearing heavy plain unornamented plate over full-length dark grave-cloth, completely covered. Its helm is smooth and featureless with no face. Imposing, solemn and sorrowful, never cruel and never gleeful. Palette strictly bone-white, grave-earth umber, cold iron grey and deep muted indigo, lit by a cold pale blue-white light. No green anywhere. Its LEFT half is solid and sharply painted. Its RIGHT half is a pale translucent echo of the same armour, ghosted and slightly out of register as though it has begun to step away from itself and stopped partway, semi-transparent so the dark background shows faintly through it. Cold pale blue-white light along the seam where the two halves fail to meet.
